Myo-Reps: Stable movement + efficient high-quality hypertrophy volume without turning every set into failure work.
Rest-Pause: Stable pulling pattern; short-rest extra reps add stimulus while technique remains easy to terminate.
DC Rest-Pause: Best reserved for stable curls where aggressive density is useful and systemic cost stays low.
Widowmaker: High-rep lower-body overload is powerful but expensive; Project America rotates it instead of prescribing it weekly.
Mechanical Drop Set: Useful occasional option when leverage can be made safer/easier without changing the target muscle.
Straight Sets: The movement already carries enough loading, stability or fatigue cost; clean straight work wins by default.
